first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person on the central Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch, with long dark hair, wearing a light-colored sleeveless top, dark pants, and light-colored shoes, with both arms bent in front of the body.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The light-brown animal immediately beside Person A's legs, with most of its front portion occluded; in the later portion, more of the outlines of its head, body, and legs are exposed on the image-right side of Person A.

entities.name: Golden Dry Grassland
entities.identification: The broad yellow-brown short-grass area covering the foreground and most of the middle ground.

entities.name: Mixed Woodland Belt
entities.identification: The trees of varying heights at the far end of the grassland, with dark green, pointed, narrow crowns interspersed with broad yellow-green to brown-green crowns.

entities.name: Pale Blue Sky
entities.identification: The pale blue sky area above the woodland and in the gaps between the tree crowns.

entities.name: Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch
entities.identification: The light gray-yellow, low, flat, sparsely grassed ground patch with irregular edges beneath and beside Person A.

entities.name: Low Grassy Mound
entities.identification: The broad, gently rising landform behind Person A and in front of the Mixed Woodland Belt, with its surface covered in golden short grass.
